claim: L3 (LFP-primary analysis spec): depth x frequency heatmap per area + superficial/deep contrast index per band per area (stim vs omission), session-bootstrap CI.
implementation: context/figures/L3_laminar_power_profile/L3_laminar_power_profile.py. Discovered and reused oa.paths.tfr_dir() precomputed TFR .npz arrays (970 files, full per-channel depth resolution) instead of recomputing from raw LFP as L0-L2 did -- much larger corpus coverage (22 sessions) than L0-L2's own manually-extracted sessions, no h5py needed. Cross-referenced outputs/layers/channel_layers_all.csv's labelled sup/deep channel calls (channel_idx matches the TFR files' local-probe-index convention directly, confirmed).
log_last_nesting: Three levels: (1) trials-then-channels-within-group pooling (L0 method a), (2) band-frequency-bin pooling, (3) final baseline division + single log10 -- verified via the synthetic self-test's sign-recovery assertion, not just asserted in a docstring.
self_test_bug_caught: First self-test run returned 0.00 dB contrast for both baked-in signatures (expected nonzero). Root cause: chained boolean-fancy-indexed in-place assignment (power[:, mask1][:, :, mask2][:, :, :, mask3] *= x) operates on a copy at each indexing step past the first and does not mutate the original array -- a real numpy footgun, not a logic error in the contrast-index math itself. Fixed by building one combined (n_ch, n_freqs, n_times) multiplier via broadcasting and applying it in a single elementwise multiply. Re-ran, both signs now recover correctly (gamma +6.02 dB, beta -6.02 dB on the synthetic data).

real_run.runtime: 31m46s -- KNOWN INEFFICIENCY: group_band_db() reloads the same session's .npz once per band (5x redundant disk I/O per session/condition), not yet fixed since output correctness is unaffected, only reproduction speed. Documented in L3's README as a follow-up.
real_run.note_V2: Only 1 session in the corpus has both labelled sup AND deep channels for V2 -- contrast index CI is degenerate (zero-width) for V2, reported honestly rather than hidden or padded.

qualitative_result: Heatmaps: real depth-localized (not depth-uniform) broadband power increase in V1/V2/MT/MST; broadband decrease across most depths in FEF, consistent with L1/L2. Contrast bar chart: MOST band/area/condition cells have wide, zero-crossing 95% CIs -- this run does NOT establish the canonical superficial-gamma/deep-beta FF/FB signature as a confirmed corpus finding. A few cells (FEF beta/omission, FEF high_gamma/stim) have both a sizeable point estimate and a CI excluding zero -- worth closer per-cell follow-up, not yet done.
not_yet_done: Fix the 5x redundant npz reload (performance only). No p-value/multiplicity correction applied across the 6 areas x 5 bands x 2 conditions = 60 contrast-index cells shown -- this is descriptive, per spec's own 'do not conclude' posture; a future inferential pass over these cells would need to declare and correct across that family (omission-statistics skill).
